LESSON: WRITING 9.5.1 CREATIVE WRITING: NARRATIVE COMPOSITIONS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.5: Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions, part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you make your composition writing better? 2. Why is it important to observe features of narrative composition in writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: A learner looks at problems in a new way and undertake the task of narrative writing and

sharing.

● Self-efficacy: A learner pays attention to detail, plan a narrative composition, and tell a chain story.

Values:
Social justice: A learner researches and writing stories of heroes and heroines exposes learners to issues like colonization,

thus enabling them to learn from the experiences of the heroes and heroines.

Link to other subjects:

● French, Arabic, German, and Chinese require narrative writing as a basic skill.

● Performing Arts: Composing plays, poems, and narratives for performance require creative writing skills.

Suggested Learning Resources

Notice boards, thumb pins, manilla papers, felt pens, braille papers, braille machines, writing materials.
